verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a comprehensive public API Reference (datadog-docs-24) covering the platform, and independent probes confirm both an llms.txt documentation index and an official MCP server, showing real API-driven/agentic access is documented and reachable. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at expected endpoints (404s in probe-2) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage beyond docs.
